messages.subject: Using command line options with stansummary
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to use the --autocorr option with stansummary, can't get autocorrelation. I used 2 chains for sampling, and used the following command: 

<cmstan-home>/bin/stansummary output-1.csv --autocorr=1

This gives me a summary but at the end I see this error:

'Bad chain index 1, aborting autocorrelation display.'

Any help will be highly appreciated. 

Thanks.

- Kedar
